specs: src/server/app/sets/plant-products/journeys/linear/features/check-answers/review-notification.e2e.spec.js — (1) fill the whole journey in stub mode via UI, open review from the hub review spoke: heading, reference caption, and EVERY captured value rendered in its card (assert the full rendered card contents including tables); (2) per-row Change link navigates to the owning page and returns to review; (3) scope omission: CTC=No hides the MRN row, usesContainers=No hides container rows, no-variety species shows no variety rows; (4) derived rollups match the entered line values; (5) nominated-contacts empty state text when none added; (6) Continue POST redirects via nextInSection; (7) axe (AxeBuilder withTags ['wcag2a','wcag2aa'], fail serious/critical) on the fully-populated render AND on a render containing at least one missing-answer message (the page has no 400 error state — collects: []).
acceptanceCriteria: GET /notifications/{journeyId}/review-notification on a complete draft renders 'Review your notification' (h1 govuk-heading-xl) with the dynamic reference caption from journeyStrip — no DRAFT->CHEDPP id-flip, the strip shows the minted GBN-PP reference throughout.

One card per captured area in hub-spoke order (about-consignment, commodities, additional-details, transport, goods-movement, contact, nominated-contacts, documents, traders) reading back every stored value; coded values render as labels resolved through the set reference services, booleans as Yes/No.

Every editable row carries its OWN Change link resolved through the dispatch index to the owning page (per-row ruling — the legacy per-page grouped links and the #country-of-origin-change-link id/row mismatch are deliberately not reproduced); read-only rows (Importer POP-1, derived rollups) have no action.

Scope-driven omission: movementReferenceNumber row only when commonTransitConvention = ADD_MRN_NOW; container rows only when usesContainers = true; grossVolumeUnit only when grossVolume answered; destination leaves only when destinationSameAsConsignee = false; varieties rows only when captured; intendedForFinalUsers only for the applicable commodity group; packer rows only when answered.
Total net weight and Total packages are DERIVED from the commodity lines and rendered read-only — never stored, no Change link.

An in-scope unanswered obligation renders a missing-answer message linking to its owning page; entry to the page remains gated by the review section's authored gate scope.readyForCheckYourAnswers (unchanged from pp-007), so the hub's review spoke stays locked until every mandatory row is complete.
Nominated contacts with zero entries renders the explicit 'No nominated contacts added' empty state, not a headers-only table.
Continue POSTs and redirects via nextInSection(page.id, scope, journeyId) (reaches declaration once pp-039 lands; hub fallback until then). No data is committed by this page (meta.collects = []).

GOV.UK toolbox only: govuk-summary-list for all name/value content, govuk-table only for commodity lines/species/measures, accompanying documents and nominated contacts; consistent h2 govuk-heading-m card headings; none of the legacy presentation-table / review-summary-list / audit-flag / heading-with-change-link / phase-tag patterns; no custom CSS.
